policy.sourceControl: This monorepo is authoritative only for applications listed in applications. SENZ is external at masinlocandher-max/Senz; apps/senz is historical. FMB News is external at masinlocandher-max/FMBNews.
policy.deployment: One independently configured Vercel project per active application boundary listed in applications. SENZ is excluded and publishes independently from masinlocandher-max/Senz. FMB News is excluded and deploys independently through Cloudflare from masinlocandher-max/FMBNews.
policy.data: No production database, authentication tenant, service-role key, or private environment variable may be shared across FMB/Yoni, SENZ, and Cognita unless explicitly approved and documented.
